$comment: Template. Copy to {capability-slug}.json — one governance file per capability.

source.reference: regulation id from ../../../../starter-regulations/{sector}.json (e.g. DP-EU-GDPR) — use the canonical id; do not invent alternatives
source.standard_reference: optional — standard id from ../../../../starter-standards/{category}.json (e.g. STD-WCAG-2-2) when the rule derives from a standard
source.jurisdiction: country code per starter-regulations/README.md (UK, EU, US, US-CA, CA, AU, SG, CH, AE, AE-DIFC, BR, GLOBAL)

rules.description: What the rule requires, in one sentence.
enforcement_points: Where in the journey / data flow the rule must be checked.
data_requirements: Data fields or records that must be captured to prove compliance.

incoming_regulation.regulation: regulation id from ../../../../starter-regulations/{sector}.json if already listed there, or a descriptive name if not yet in the starter library
